toegepas.voor: van die begin af om daardie enjin ontwerp
toegepas.na: van die begin af rondom daardie enjin ontwerp
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'rondom' states the spatial sense (designed around the engine) unambiguously for a Grade 4 reader, where bare 'om' first reads as 'in order to'; no words added.
toegepas.fout: Bare 'om' before 'daardie enjin ontwerp' first reads as the infinitive 'om ... te', so a Grade 4 reader stumbles before finding the spatial sense.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Rondom' carries the same meaning (the vehicle was designed around the engine), adds no words, touches no protected wording, and removes the stumble.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: goedkoop genoeg gemaak vir gewone gesinne
laat_vaar_vorige.na: goedkoop genoeg vir gewone gesinne gemaak
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The past participle belongs at the end of the clause; the phrase placed after it reads like English word order.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Placing 'vir gewone gesinne' after the participle is normal Afrikaans and reads easily, so moving it is a lateral move.
